feeds.title: Booklover Book Reviews
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jo, an unabashed book lover living in Brisbane, Australia. Since starting this website in 2009 I've come to realise I enjoy writing about books almost as much as reading them. Read hundreds of book reviews, wide range of titles by Australian and international authors, book giveaways, author interviews. Find your next great read today!

feeds.title: Booktopia Blog
feeds.description: Voted Australia's Favourite Bookstore. We love books and want to spread the word. Delivering more than 4 million books per year, we offer competitive prices and stock a wide range to guarantee faster delivery times. Bringing together writers and readers, combined with our expert opinion, Booktopia is Australia's local bookstore.

feeds.title: Kids' Book Review
feeds.description: Kids Book Review is a voluntary children's literature and book review which works with authors, illustrators and publishers Australia-wide and internationally. We cover news, reviews, interviews, articles, guest posts, events, specialist literacy articles and much more, attracting readers from all over the world including teachers, librarians, industry professionals and parents and kids.

feeds.title: The Book Muse
feeds.description: I'm Ashleigh, a book reviewer, student, aspiring author and hopeful editor living in Terrigal, NSW. I have always loved books and writing, and it is an area I would like to work in. I support my local bookstore, going online for things that I can't get there. I hope you enjoy my blog

feeds.title: Whispering Gums
feeds.description: A reader, filmgoer, concertgoer living downunder, who has been blogging since May 2009. My on-line booklife began in the mid-1990s when I joined several internet bookgroups, but this blog is now my prime on-line book presence. My main focus is book reviews but I occasionally stray into other areas of literature and even further into other topics of cultural interest (to me)

feeds.title: Happy Indulgence
feeds.description: Book review blog from Australia featuring young adult reviews and discussions. I started Happy Indulgence in July 2012 as a way to share my passion with others, and it has expanded into a YA book review blog encompassing a wide range of features and genres. Happy Indulgence captures how we should blissfully enjoy life's greatest offerings, no matter what it is. Here, we share our love for YA books and all things reading!

feeds.title: Crokes Blog
feeds.description: Crokes is a social media platform that empowers readers to connect and openly discuss books and other topics without being tracked, supporting free journalism and anonymity.

feeds.title: Lost in a Good Book
feeds.description: A librarian, a blogger, a reader, and a lover of books. Lost in a Good Book is a blog about books, reviews, and all things reading.

feeds.title: ANZ LitLovers Lit
feeds.description: Welcome to the ANZ LitLovers blog. It started out as a blog for an online reading group, and while it still retains its role as a portal to the group, its primary function now is as Lisa Hill's ANZ LitLovers LitBlog where you can find reviews and commentary about literary fiction, classics and non-fiction from Australia and New Zealand. There are also regular blog posts about contemporary international fiction with a special interest in translations, and the classics.

feeds.title: book'd out
feeds.description: A voracious, eclectic reader I work with a number of publishers to promote Australian and international titles across social media channels. Have a look at my blog for book reviews & news. I'm passionate about reading in a variety of genres.

feeds.title: The Chrysalis BREW Project Blog
feeds.description: The Chrysalis BREW Project is a community of readers and writers helping each other and others grow. Here, you'll find book news, book awards, book reviews, book recommendations, and audiobooks.

feeds.title: The Burgeoning Bookshelf
feeds.description: I started reading children's Middle Grade and Young Adult as my children brought English texts home from school. My reading preferences now include Romance, Rural Romance, Suspense, Mystery, Crime, Fantasy, Historical Fiction, Contemporary Women's, Young Adult, fictional war stories and Middle Grade.

feeds.title: Tinted Edges
feeds.description: Angharad, an avid reader & book lover, uses this blog for all her reviews and to feature great books & editions she came across. She reads fiction & non-fiction, and her favourite genres are literary fiction, biopunk, magic realism, creative non-fiction and microhistories.

feeds.title: Readability Australia
feeds.description: My name is Fleur Morrison and I am a hopeless bibliophile. I read on the beach, in bed, on the train, in cafes anywhere and any chance I can get. I'm looking forward to sharing my thoughts, ideas and reviews with you and I hope you can share yours, too.

feeds.title: Just Write For Kids Australia Blog
feeds.description: Just Write For Kids is Australia's popular promotional website for book authors, writers and illustrators in the children's literature industry.

feeds.title: Newtown Review of Books
feeds.description: The Newtown Review of Books was established in March 2012 by Jean Bedford and Linda Funnell as an independent site for book reviews. We believe that a strong reviewing culture is important for both writers and readers. The Newtown Review of Books reviews fiction, memoir, biography, history, politics and true crime. Our tastes are eclectic, and we aim to provide intelligent reviews of books people will want to read. We post new reviews twice a week.

feeds.title: The Mostly Books Blog
feeds.description: Adelaide's oldest bookstore still in existence. Proudly independent and committed to excellent customer service.

feeds.title: Juanita Kees Blog
feeds.description: Juanita escapes the real world by reading and writing Australian Rural Romance novels with elements of suspense, Australian Fantasy Paranormal and Small Town USA stories. Her romance novels star spirited heroines who give the hero a run for his money before giving in. She creates emotionally engaging worlds steeped in romance, suspense, mystery and intrigue, set in dusty, rural outback Australia and on the NASCAR racetracks of America.

feeds.title: Upside-Down Books
feeds.description: Kirstie is an Australian book blogger who has a keen interest in dragons and history and loves to surround herself with all things bookish! Through this blog, she posts her book reviews discussions, reviewing tips, and more.

feeds.title: BookishBron
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Bron! I'm an Australian book blogger and reviewer, living in Ngunnawal Country in Canberra. I'm passionate about reading and supporting Australian books and authors, from kids' books to young adult and adult fiction. Join me here as I talk about my latest and favorite reads, and my bookish life.

feeds.title: Robinsons BookBlog
feeds.description: Robinsons BookBlog is a lively literary hub from Australia's Robinsons Bookshop, offering book-loving readers curated new-release picks, thoughtful thematic guides, community event highlights, and heartfelt reading recommendations across genres.

feeds.title: Reading Matters
feeds.description: Explore book reviews from a diverse group of genres main focus with the main focus on modern and contemporary fiction. The Reading Matters blog is edited by Kim Forrester, a self-confessed book addict who likes to share her love of books with a broader audience.

feeds.title: WorkingType Books
feeds.description: Information and tips, focusing on publishing, publicity, promotional ideas, author profiles, design resources and more.

feeds.title: Australian Book Review
feeds.description: Australian Book Review (ABR) is Australia's leading arts and literary review. Created in 1961, and now based in Melbourne, ABR publishes reviews, essa...

feeds.title: Readability Australia
feeds.description: Fleur Morrison is a hopeless bibliophile. She read on the beach, in bed, on the train, in cafes- anywhere and any chance I can get. Here, she is looking forward to sharing her thoughts, ideas and reviews with us.

feeds.title: PMI Victorian History Library » Book Review
feeds.description: The PMI Victorian History Library's book review blog features thoughtful critiques and community-driven reflections on new fiction and history titles.

feeds.title: Bookface Blog
feeds.description: Bookface Stores' blog is a friendly, bookshop-powered space sharing literary recommendations, author interviews, staff highlights, local literary news, and heartwarming community moments that celebrate books and the readers who love them.

feeds.title: Books Are My Favourite and Best
feeds.description: Books Are My Favourite & Best is a thoughtful, reader-driven blog by Kate W where literary passion meets eclectic curation.

feeds.title: Harper Collins Australia Blog
feeds.description: HarperCollins Australia is the oldest publisher -with a heritage dating back to the 19th Century. Today HarperCollins produces print and e-books, generally simultaneously, and was one of the first Australian publishers to turn much of the deep backlist into e-books to broaden the life of a book. The blog is filled with the latest launched books.

feeds.title: Carpe Librum
feeds.description: This Australian book blog contains book reviews across various genres, regular book giveaways, blog tours and author interviews.

feeds.title: Books+Publishing
feeds.description: Books+Publishing is Australia's premier trade news platform for the book industry, delivering daily updates, prepublication reviews, rights roundups, bestseller charts, job listings, and cultural analysis to publishers, booksellers, librarians, and literary professionals.

feeds.title: Australia Reads
feeds.description: A not-for-profit initiative of the Australian books industry to get more people reading more books, more often.

feeds.title: Inside Story » Books & Arts
feeds.description: Inside Story's Books & Arts section delivers cultural journalism that blends sharp literary and art criticism with essays, reporting, and commentary from leading Australian thinkers.

feeds.title: The Spectator Australia » Books
feeds.description: The Spectator Australia is a conservative weekly magazine and online platform offering political commentary, opinion, and cultural analysis. It is the Australian edition of the UK-based Spectator, known for its centre-right to right-wing editorial stance, featuring prominent conservative voices and debates on Australian politics, society, and global affairs.

feeds.title: My BookClub Reviews » Australian
feeds.description: The Australian Book category on My BookClub Reviews features heartfelt, carefully crafted reviews of books by Australian authors.

feeds.title: Aussie Reviews
feeds.description: Since 2001 Aussie Reviews has been drawing attention to the wonderful literary talent in this country by providing online reviews of all kinds of Australian books from adult fiction to children's books to non-fiction.

feeds.title: Aus Rom Today
feeds.description: AusRomToday.com is a hot new site designed to celebrate the Australian romance literature industry and community, and to draw attention to the achievements and acclaim of Australian writers. Keep up-to-date with the Australian romance fiction industry with AusRom Today. Author interviews, reviews, new and upcoming releases, and giveaways!

feeds.title: AustCrimeFiction
feeds.description: Well it's basically a database of Authors and Books from Australasia (Australia, New Zealand, and nearby areas) AND a blog AND a running commentary (on the rare occasions when I feel brave enough to post an article). It's also the place where I post book reviews. A big percentage of the books I read will be from local authors (books that are covered under Books & Writers here).

feeds.title: Books Wheel Blog
feeds.description: We are a book review website. Our mission is to provide quality, unbiased reviews of new and old books so that you can make the best decision for your reading pleasure. We aim to provide our readers with honest and unbiased book reviews, as well as book recommendations. Our team believes we can help you find the perfect read for your reading needs by providing quality, unbiased book reviews.

feeds.title: Dusk Angel Reads
feeds.description: Dusk Angel Store is an eCommerce site that provides homemade goods that mostly relate to Books! You'll find book reviews written by Eliza Eames.

feeds.title: Diva Booknerd
feeds.description: -Australian Young Adult and middle grade book review blog. Featuring new releases, discussions, giveaways and more.

feeds.title: The Never Ending Bookshelf
feeds.description: I'm Jess from the land down under aka Australia. I'm an avid reader and writer and pretty much devote all my spare time to these two loves. The Never Ending Bookshelf is a blog focused on everything book related. It features a wide range of reviews across various genres, author interview, guest posts and occasionally giveaways

feeds.title: ALPHA reader
feeds.description: Hello, I am Danielle, I could go really far back and say that I have loved reading from the moment that my mum started buying me Little Golden Books at the Coles check-out. My blog is nothing fancy. I prefer Spartan over flash, and I am more concerned with writing long, sincere and rambling reviews than aesthetics. This is just a little list of pointers I try to write by, based on my own preferences, likes and dislikes.

feeds.title: Tru-Life Fiction
feeds.description: Anita Wright has had a fascination with writing since the age of twelve. Though she was born and raised in the Midwest, she has enjoyed life in the South and on the West Coast.

feeds.title: Genie In A Book
feeds.description: Welcome to Genie in a Book! This is a blog for reviews, author interviews, features and more, from a book-selling bookworm whose TBR pile is always taller than she is.

feeds.title: Brona's Books
feeds.description: Book reviews - all ages, (nearly) all genres, lots of Australian titles. Host of AusReading Month (November)

feeds.title: Francine Rodriguez Blog
feeds.description: My name is Francine Rodriguez, and I am an author, but I wasn't always an author. I grew up in and around the skid row area of downtown Los Angeles. Later, I worked as a Civil Rights and Equal Employment Opportunity Investigator in the Federal sector. Altogether, before becoming Francine Rodriquez, Author, I worked in the fields of law and psychology for over thirty years. It is my experience as a professional in those fields that inform my writing.

feeds.title: The~Rest~Is~Still~Unwritten
feeds.description: My name's Rachel and I'm a 26 year old Australian blogger who simply adores books. I was an avid reader when I was younger then in my early teens that kind of diminished. But now I rediscovered my love of reading and cannot stop

feeds.title: A Book Escape
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Alana. I live in Melbourne, Australia, and my life is completely taken over by being a mum to 4 young children, and one thing I love to do for myself and my self-care is reading. So to give me something else to do in the little free time I get I decided to blog reviews on the books I read. Everyone knows you can't have things 100% to yourself so even though I'll primarily be blogging about books, a few blogs of the kids might sneak in there.

feeds.title: Ragamuffin Books Blog
feeds.description: I am Sarah Rasmussen - a passionate reader and writer of children's fiction.I am currently studying MA in writing with a focus on children's literature. I am passionate about all things children's fiction and believe that every child can be a book lover.

feeds.title: Jennifer's Best Bookish Blog
feeds.description: Best Bookish Blog is Jennifer's heartfelt, reader-first book review blog—coverin.g a broad range of genres with candid star-rated opinions.

feeds.title: Kathryn's Inbox
feeds.description: I am an Australian author, book critic and poet with a slightly odd sense of humour. I write book reviews and interview various authors on my blog.

feeds.title: Talking Books Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Talking Books Blog! A website where we talk about new releases, old favourites and soon to be released books! Book reviews, blog tour spotlights, author Q&A's, guest posts, cover reveals, recommendations and general book chit chat! Our preferred reading genre is women's fiction, romance, new adult, mystery/thriller, paranormal/fantasy, sci-fi and historical romance.

feeds.title: Sydney Review of Books
feeds.description: Sparked by concerns about the dwindling space for literary criticism in Australian media, the Sydney Review of Books was founded by the Writing and Society Research Centre at UWS in January 2013 as an online review site focusing on Australian writers and writing.
